questions.question: On whose lap was Lord Krishna pleased to place His lotus feet because that person was very meek and gentle?
questions.explanation: "The Personality of Godhead, Sri Krishna, was pleased to place His lotus feet on the lap of Vidura because Vidura was very meek and gentle." (SB 3.13.5)

questions.question: What did Brahma ask Manu to do to render the best service unto him?

options.text: Beget qualified children and rule the world in devotional service
Travel to all the holy places

questions.explanation: "...I ask you to beget children qualified like yourself in the womb of your wife. Rule the world in pursuance of the principles of devotional service unto the Supreme Personality of Godhead..." (SB 3.13.11)

questions.question: What problem with the earth did Manu ask Brahma to solve so that it could be the dwelling place for all living entities?

options.text: It was merged in the great water
It was floating in the sky

questions.explanation: "...please attempt to lift the earth, which is merged in the great water, because it is the dwelling place for all the living entities." (SB 3.13.15)

questions.question: From which part of Brahma did the small form of a boar come out?
questions.explanation: "...all of a sudden, while Brahma was engaged in thinking, a small form of a boar came out of his nostril." (SB 3.13.18)

questions.question: How big was the boar when it first came out of Brahma's nostril?

options.text: Not more than the upper portion of a thumb

questions.explanation: "The measurement of the creature was not more than the upper portion of a thumb." (SB 3.13.18)

questions.question: As Brahma watched, the boar quickly became situated in the sky as gigantic as what?
questions.explanation: "...that boar became situated in the sky in a wonderful manifestation as gigantic as a great elephant." (SB 3.13.19)

questions.question: How did the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Vishnu, in the boar form enliven Brahma and the brahmanas?

options.text: By roaring tumultuously like a great mountain

questions.explanation: "While Brahma was deliberating with his sons, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Vishnu, roared tumultuously like a great mountain." (SB 3.13.23)

questions.question: When Lord Boar dived into the water like a giant mountain, what appeared as the arms of the ocean?
questions.explanation: "...Lord Boar divided the middle of the ocean, and two high waves appeared as the arms of the ocean..." (SB 3.13.29)

questions.question: How did Lord Boar get the earth out of the water?

options.text: He carried it in His arms
He took it on His tusks
He pushed it with His hooves
He balanced it on His head

questions.explanation: "Lord Boar very easily took the earth on His tusks and got it out of the water." (SB 3.13.31)

questions.question: While lifting the earth, whom did Lord Boar immediately kill?
questions.explanation: "...His anger glowing like the Sudarsana wheel, He immediately killed the demon [Hiranyaksa], although he tried to fight with the Lord." (SB 3.13.31)

questions.question: What happened to the cheeks and tongue of the Lord after He killed the demon within the water?

options.text: They became smeared with the blood of the demon

questions.explanation: "The cheeks and tongue of the Lord became smeared with the blood of the demon, just as an elephant becomes reddish from digging in the purple earth." (SB 3.13.32)

questions.question: What complexion did the Lord assume while suspending the earth on His tusks like an elephant?

options.text: A bluish complexion like that of a tamala tree

questions.explanation: "He assumed a bluish complexion like that of a tamala tree..." (SB 3.13.33)

questions.question: According to the sages' prayers, what are submerged in the hair holes of Lord Boar's body?
questions.explanation: "...and in the hair holes of Your body the oceans are submerged." (SB 3.13.34)

questions.question: In the prayers, what are described as plates of sacrifice of the Lord?

options.text: The tongue, nostril, belly and ears

questions.explanation: "O Lord, Your tongue is a plate of sacrifice, Your nostril is another plate of sacrifice, in Your belly is the eating plate of sacrifice, and another plate of sacrifice is the holes of Your ears." (SB 3.13.36)

questions.question: According to the prayers, the Lord's neck is the place for what?
questions.explanation: "Your neck is the place for three desires, and Your tusks are the result of initiation and the end of all desires." (SB 3.13.37)

questions.question: The earth lifted on the Lord's tusks is compared to what beautiful object?

options.text: A lotus flower sustained by an infuriated elephant

questions.explanation: "...the earth with its mountains, which You have lifted with Your tusks, is situated as beautifully as a lotus flower with leaves sustained by an infuriated elephant just coming out of the water." (SB 3.13.40)

questions.question: In the prayers, the earth is described as the Lord's what?
questions.explanation: "...this earth is Your wife, and You are the supreme father." (SB 3.13.42)

questions.question: How were the sages of the Jana, Tapas and Satya lokas purified by the Lord?

options.text: By the drops of water sprinkled from His shoulder hairs

questions.explanation: "...but still we have been purified by the drops of water sprinkled from Your shoulder hairs by the shaking of Your body." (SB 3.13.44)

questions.question: After raising the earth and placing it afloat on the water, what did Lord Vishnu do?

options.text: He returned to His own abode

questions.explanation: "...He returned to His own abode." (SB 3.13.47)

questions.question: What is the benefit of hearing and describing the narration of Lord Boar in a devotional service attitude?

options.text: The Lord, who is within the heart of everyone, is very pleased

questions.explanation: "If one hears and describes in a devotional service attitude this auspicious narration of Lord Boar, which is worthy of description, the Lord, who is within the heart of everyone, is very pleased." (SB 3.13.48)

Lord in the form of boar had ________ complexion.

Lord Boar took the earth on His tusks and got it out of ________.
Lord's ________ is the place for three desires.
